note: Marten River campground in Lesser Slave Lake Provincial Park, about 32 km north of Slave Lake on Hwy 88: treed, well-spaced sites a short walk (by stairs) from the lake beach. Loops A and B suit RVs better; C and D have smaller sites better suited to tents. Coin-operated showers. No boat launch at the campground (the nearest is the Slave Lake municipal launch, 30 km south); a hand-launch path runs from the day-use area. The stairs from Loop A (between A-28 and A-29) and the southern stairs from Loop B (between B-23 and B-24) are closed for structural problems (Alberta Parks, Sep 18, 2026, until further notice). Freighter Lakeshore Trail access. --Claude
